author: xCirne
quote:
It's not like the game is bad or anything but this is NOT GTA. Clearly Rockstar intended to make an exepriment and tried to apply Red Dead Redemption 2 gameplay to GTA but the context is not the same, the essence of GTA is to have freedom, to do whatever you like shoot rockets to cars do chaos kill whoever you feel like killing, buying houses, cars, get hella rich.
But instead you can't just go and kill people even in missions because of the karma system, you can't buy houses, can't buy cars, can't even keep your own fish after catching it.

As a player who completed all Rockstar games I had the expectations really high because this company never let us down. But this time I feel completely fooled and betrayed. You made me (us) wait 13 years! past hundreds of delays to "make the game perfect and what you delivered is this romance game with no freedom and lots of restrictions. If you want to make a different kind of don't call it "GTA" but everyone knows that wouldn't sell as much as this disguised Life Simulator sold. 

I swear i don't understand the unanimous opinions from the "Universal acclaim", has anyone of them even played the game or any GTA at all or were they just paid to say the games is the best of all time?

PS: This is also the first game I ever pre-ordered and if I got a chance to refund my 100 and buy in 5 or 6 years when it gets cheaped I wouldn't think twice, This serves as an eye opener to not buy anything on pre-order sales.
